name: freellama-workspace
description: Workspace root for FreeLlama's internal Rust core, portable JavaScript entry points, and per-platform native artifact packages.

scripts.build: yarn build:rust && yarn build:native && yarn workspaces foreach -A --topological run build
scripts.build:native: napi build --platform --release --manifest-path packages/rust-core/Cargo.toml --features napi --no-js --no-dts-header --dts .napi-generated.d.ts -o packages/mcp/native && node packages/mcp/scripts/remove-generated-dts.mjs
scripts.test:all: yarn typecheck && yarn test && yarn test:rust && yarn test:agents && yarn test:integration && yarn test:e2e
scripts.verify:production: yarn build && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && yarn test:all && yarn release:verify:publish
